title: GonogoAlternateData

required.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

good.description: False: under its alternate minimums; null: the pilot's to check; left out: says nothing.

closed.description: NASR lists the field closed (ARPT_STATUS CI or CP): never an alternate, a stop (decision 0043).

failed.description: True where the check was asked and could not be made: under IFR the alternate is then unknown, never ok (14 CFR 91.169(b)).

pending.description: True while an app still awaits the check: the alternate is then pending.

description: The planner's /api/alternate answer, as much as the finding reads, or {"failed": true} where it could not be had, {"pending": true} while it is awaited.
